svg.title: Three curves whose tangent makes zero net turns
svg.desc: Rhythms 2/3, 4/7, and 6/11 have strangeness 0, minus 1, and minus 1. Blue rings mark positive crossing weights; gold squares mark negative weights, starting at the rightmost point. All three curves have tangent index zero.

g.text: All three directions make zero net turns. Their crossings tell another story.
○ Blue: weight +1. □ Gold: weight −1. Start at the rightmost point.
Multiply each weight by the crossing’s mean winding count, then add.
Moving the start changes the weights. A starting-edge correction keeps strangeness fixed.
Exact integer counts from rational smooth crossing certificates; the plotted paths use sampled, rounded coordinates.
